## Duplicate check

- [ ] I have searched the existing issues and did not find a duplicate documentation request.

## Documentation area

Which area needs documentation?

- [ ] Installation
- [ ] Configuration
- [ ] Deployment
- [ ] Operations
- [ ] User Guide
- [ ] Admin Guide
- [ ] Developer Guide
- [ ] API / Interfaces
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Troubleshooting
- [ ] Other

## What should be documented or changed?

Describe the missing, unclear, outdated, or incorrect documentation.

Example: The production deployment steps do not explain how to configure the systemd service override.

## Expected documentation

What should the documentation explain?

The documentation should include:

- Required paths
- Required environment variables
- Exact commands
- Verification steps

## Affected documentation files or pages

Link or name the affected files/pages if known.

Example: `README.md`, `docs/deployment/production.md`, Wiki page URL

## Additional context

Add anything else that may help us improve the documentation.
